title: UtcPlan
description: Operational dive survey plan describing survey sites, dates, timezones, and planned transect time windows.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this operational plan schema.

timezone.description: Default IANA time zone identifier (e.g. 'America/Los_Angeles' or 'UTC') for interpreting wall-clock timecodes.

date.description: Optional default survey date (YYYY-MM-DD) if shared across all sites.

sites.description: List of survey sites visited during the dive operations.

items.title: Site
items.description: A survey site containing location metadata and planned transects.

name.description: Unique name or identifier for the survey site (e.g. 'Jack_Block_Park', 'Centennial_Park').

project.description: Project, client, or expedition identifier associated with the site (e.g. 'Port_of_Seattle', 'testing').

date.description: Survey date for this site in ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format.

notes.description: Optional operational notes or context for this survey site.

transects.description: Ordered list of planned survey transects conducted at this site.

items.title: Transect
items.description: A planned scientific survey transect defined by a start and end timecode window.

name.description: Unique label or identifier for the transect within the site (e.g. 'T1', 'T2', 'T5').

start_tc.description: Transect planned start timecode in local wall-clock time (HH:MM:SS or HH:MM:SS.sss).

end_tc.description: Transect planned stop / end timecode in local wall-clock time (HH:MM:SS or HH:MM:SS.sss).

start.description: Optional alternative start timestamp (epoch timestamp in seconds or ISO-8601 datetime string).

end.description: Optional alternative end timestamp (epoch timestamp in seconds or ISO-8601 datetime string).

notes.description: Optional notes or operational observations for this transect.
